messages:
alex.li: Uploaded a lightweight preview for notification matrix + suppression in Figma: https://figma.redwood/notify-matrix-lite. Goal: quick in-console simulator showing per-channel payloads and whether an event would actually send.

maria.g: Nice. Please make sure it covers: single-channel, multi-channel fanout, channel-level mute, and global mute.

alex.li: Yep. Frames include: baseline, fanout, channel-muted, global-muted. Also added a severity selector to vary payload.

jonathan: UX nit: the badge "Muted 30m" confuses scope. Suggest "Muted (All channels) 30m" for global and "Muted 30m" for channel.

kyle: Copy alternatives: "Silenced", "Muted", "Silence window". We should A/B with PMs.

sophie: A11y: suppressed state low contrast. Need AA contrast and non-color indicator (icon + text). Keyboard: focus should land on severity, arrows to move channels.

accessibility-pat: Recommend #4B5563 for body text on white. Add aria-live on preview region: "Preview updated: Slack will send; Email suppressed". Ensure channel toggles have aria-checked.

maria.g: For statuses use short verbs: "Will send", "Suppressed", "Fallbacked". Cleaner in dense UI.

jonathan: Preview should show provenance: tiny line like "reason: mute" or "reason: route -> low-priority". Expand to show rule name + ID. IDs hidden by default.

alex.li: I mocked provenance under header with info icon; expansion shows name + ID + link to rule editor.

kyle: Also added a "Simulate failure" checkbox to advanced preview so we can show fallback behavior (default off).

sophie: Ensure color isn't the only indicator; add icons and aria-describedby for provenance when expanded.

maria.g: I'll run a quick PM poll on copy options tomorrow and post results.

alex.li: Action items: maria run copy poll, pat do contrast + SR pass, jonathan write precedence spec for preview, kyle document keyboard flows. I'll iterate frames later today. :sparkles:
